name: 作業表の列見出し
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Create ONE static Japanese table column header component for Lighthouse LH09-0026「作業表の列見出し」. Original images 1 and 2 are the primary authority for proportions, alignment, spacing, fine divider weight and visible structure. Image 3 supplies Japanese wording only. Do not include the application sidebar, toolbar, task rows, branding, watermark, extra icons or invented controls.
Make a tightly framed extremely wide shallow strip, approximately 1188 by 36 logical pixels, with seven columns. Match the original column-width ratios precisely: 522,114,114,132,114,113,80. Thin vertical neutral-gray dividers and fine horizontal top/bottom rules; no heavy outer border. Pure white #FFFFFF canvas and cells. Each label is left aligned, 8px inset, vertically centered. No shadows or colored fills on this ordinary table header.
Exact visible Japanese labels, left to right:「名称」「担当者」「期日」「完了日」「予定工数」「実績工数」「期間」. Meiryo Regular, small metadata role 12px/16px, zero tracking, neutral slate #526173. All labels regular weight, no bold. Preserve the compact readable hierarchy and exact one-line state. No ellipses needed for these Japanese words.
Render the entire strip with all seven columns visible and very little outside whitespace. This is a flat crisp UI screenshot, not a mockup on a desk, not a perspective view, not a full page or comparison board.
reviewNotes: 全7列の日本語、原本由来の列幅比・細い区切り・通常ウェイトを目視確認。アイコンの追加なし。画像外側の白い余白が大きい点を残差として記録。正確なフォント同一性・ピクセル一致・実装動作・所有者承認は未証明。エージェントによる静的画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存
